'''Hellhound Hunters''' are monsters that can be encountered in [[The Zamorakian Undercity]]. These can be summoned by [[Zamorakian hound master]]s and the miniboss [[Desha, Guardian of the Hounds]].

Their attacks can inflict the [[Savage Wounds]] bleed.
